versions.changelog:
- Initial release of UI Page Replication V1 skill for high-fidelity replication of backend/admin UI pages.
- Supports detailed extraction and recreation of all UI elements, interactions, and layouts—including tabs, modals, forms, tables, and styling.
- Integrates Playwright/browser-driven page inspection to capture complete UI details and generate supporting artifacts.
- Outputs matching TypeScript interfaces, mock data, and API layers reflecting original page semantics.
- Ensures adherence to host project’s framework, routing, component libraries, and styling conventions.
- Provides access to reference source files for configuration, prompts, schema, and utilities.
